portrait.guidance: The 800×800 portrait is a tight head-and-shoulders crop with neutral textured gray background and black shirt. Hair begins y≈26 (3% margin); eyes y≈353 (44%); chin y≈662 (83%). The face is large, roughly x=191–616 (53% width), with shoulders only in the bottom quarter. Direct eye contact and an open smile make the technical offer personable. Soft frontal light keeps both eyes clear and leaves natural skin texture; background is slightly darker and warmer on the right. This is the closest crop among these five references, so recognition is strong at tiny avatar sizes. A strict circular crop can approach the hair/shoulder edges; keep a few percent more headroom in the new version.
